long_biography.plain_text:
Australian accountant Anthony Francis Bell turned competitive sailing into a fundraising platform through the Loyal Foundation. The charity directs all money it raises to children's health organisations. His service to charity and sailing earned him the Medal of the Order of Australia, and he has served as a patron of the Australian Sailing Team.

Bell also skippered two line-honours victories in the Sydney Hobart race. His 2011 team prevailed after a close finish, while the 2016 crew broke the race record by almost five hours. The second victory completed a pair of wins achieved five years apart with different Loyal teams.
